FULL TEXT:
RECRUITMENT NOTICE
No. NU/NT/Job/Sep-2026 Date: 08.10.2026
Nalanda University, Rajgir is an avant-garde “International” University, designated as
institution of “National Importance” established by an Act of the Indian Parliament (Nalanda
University Act, 2010) under the aegis of the Ministry of External Affairs, GOI.
The University invites applications from eligible candidates for the engagement of staff on
project basis under the Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS) research project titled: “Traditional
Coastal Navigation Practices in Cyclone-Prone Regions of India: for the following Non-
Teaching Positions on contract on consolidated Pay basis:
Name of the Post : Research Assistant
No. of the Post : 02
Nature of Engagement : On Contract for a period of 06 Months
(Extendable based on performance reviewed and project
requirements)
Total Period : The total period of engagement shall be for a maximum of
02 years or coterminous with the Project.
Pay : Rs. 25,000/- per month Consolidated
Minimum Educational Qualifications and Experience:
Undergraduate degree in any discipline; postgraduate qualification in any discipline will
be desirable.
The Last date for receiving applications is 31.10.2026. Applications received after
the closing date will be rejected and no correspondence shall be entertained in this
regard.
HOW TO APPLY:
1. Candidates are required to apply only through the Link given at end of the
advertisement or on the University Website. No hard copy of the application
will be accepted. Since the link is based on a Google Form, you are requested to
log in to your Gmail account before clicking on the link. If you do not have a Gmail
Account, please create one before accessing the link.
2. APPLICATION PROCESS:
The application process has following two mandatory stages:
(A) Filling of Application Form (Google Form) and
(B) Forwarding copy of filled Application Form to Recruitment Cell, Nalanda
University.
(A) FILLING OF APPLICATION FORM (GOOGLE FORM)
(i) Click on the given Link and carefully fill all the required details given in the
Application Form, and then SUBMIT.
(ii) After successful submission of the Application Form, the applicant will receive a
copy of the Filled Application Form on his/her registered Email.
(B) FORWARDING OF APPLICATION
The applicant is required to FORWARD the copy of filled Application Form
(Do not compose a separate email; only Forward) to the Recruitment Cell,
Nalanda University at recruitment@nalandauniv.edu.in along with the
enclosure of a SINGLE PDF FILE Containing - Updated CV with Passport Size
Photograph; Qualification Certificates and Mark Sheets; Experience
Certificates and Other relevant supporting documents.
3. Merely filling the Application Form shall not be considered completion of the
application process. The application process shall be considered complete only
upon forwarding the Application Form along with enclosure of all the required
document to recruitment@nalandauniv.edu.in on or before the closing date of the
Notice.
4. Enclosure should be a SINGLE PDF FILE only containing- all the required documents
mentioned above. Submission of multiple files, separate emails, or files in ZIP, RAR,
or any other compressed file format will lead to rejection of the Application Form.
5. Applicants must use the same email address for filling the Application Form and
forwarding Filled Application Form.
6. Applicants must not submit the required documents separately or through
multiple/part-wise emails.
7. Incomplete applications or applications without required supporting
documents; and application received after closing date will be liable to be
rejected, and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained.
8. Documents must be clearly scanned using a proper scanner and submitted in a
clean, legible, and printable format. Scanned documents that are tilted, distorted,
unclear, cropped, or otherwise not suitable for printing, particularly those scanned
using mobile phones, may lead to rejection of the application.
9. Applicants are advised to submit only ONE application for each post. Multiple
applications or multiple emails submitted for the same post may lead to rejection of
the application(s).
10. An application fee of Rs. 500/- shall be paid online directly to the University’s
Bank Account (through Net Banking / UPI). The UTR Number/Transaction
Reference Number must be mentioned in the Application Form for reference.
Details of the University’s Bank Account are given below.
Name of Account : Nalanda University
Bank Name : HDFC Bank Ltd.
Account No. : 50100079546912
IFSC Code : HDFC0002059
Swift Code : HDFCINBB
Branch Address : Dharamsala Road, Rajgir – 803 116
GENERAL INSTRUCTION:
1. The Applicants must be citizens of India.
2. The candidate is responsible for the information filled in the Application Form.
3. Incomplete application Forms shall not be considered for shortlisting and the criteria
of shortlisting shall be as per the Institutional requirements and norms.
4. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing for the selection process. Any changes of dates
etc. also will be communicated either by publishing in the website and thus candidates
are requested to visit the website regularly.
5. Mere fulfilment of essential qualifications and specialization requirements does not
entitle any candidate for a call to the interview. Short-listing criteria may be set higher
than the advertised (if required).
6. The Nalanda University reserves all rights to increase or decrease the number of
position and fill/not fill the advertised post.
7. The interview shall be conducted in Offline / Online mode as applicable. Timings shall
be shared after the scrutiny of applications by email only.
8. The decision of the University related to all matters pertaining to the selection shall be
final and binding on the applicants. No candidate will have any claim for issue of
appointment letter, as a matter of right, even after recommendations by the Selection
(Interview) Committee.
9. Selected candidate must be ready to join immediately.
10. Any other rule, as applicable will be followed, although not mentioned above.
11. Intimation about the Shortlisted Candidates for Interview and the selected candidate
will be informed via email only and they are expected to join immediately. Applicants
are advised to mention their correct and active email ID in the application, as all
correspondences will be through email only. Hence, regular checking of the email by
the applicant is expected.
Sd/-
Registrar (I/C)
